name: popover
title: Auro Popover
description: Positioning + portal primitive. Owns Floating UI geometry (offset / flip / shift / width-matching + autoUpdate) and portals its content. The headless core stays DOM-free; this primitive computes coordinates. Shared by select and combobox.

auro.docs: Wrap overlay content in <Popover anchorRef={ref} open={open}>. Anchors to the referenced element, flips/shifts to stay in view, matches the anchor's width, and renders through a portal. Requires the @floating-ui/react peer dependency.
